articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that it will report its fourth quarter 2021 earnings results on February 10, 2022, after the market closes. The Company’s earnings release and any supplemental information will be posted on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website – www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . InvenTrust will host an earnings conference call to discuss the Company’s results and business highlights on Friday, February 11, 2022, at 11:00 a.m. ET. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website. Fourth Quarter 2021 Earnings Conference Call Date: Friday, February 11, 2022 Time: 11:00 a.m. ET Dial-In Number: (866) 652-5200 Webcast Link: https://services.choruscall.com/links/ivt220210.html Replay Webcast Archive: www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ About InvenTrust Properties Corp. InvenTrust Properties Corp. (IVT) is a premier Sun Belt multi-tenant essential retail
